page.layout: One printed page: a full-page engraved frontispiece (an apocalyptic scene with angels, clouds, smoke and figures), with a printed title block in the lower left corner, below the picture.
page.notes: Engraving, not text: an angel standing on the sea with a raised arm, figures of the damned and the saved below, angels with trumpets and torches in the clouds, a large dark cloud of smoke at top centre. The title block in the lower left is partly cut off at the left edge of the scan, so the first line is incomplete and the start of "HENRICI" and "DIATRIBAE" is uncertain. The lines "Cum Privilegio" and "et Westfrisiae" are small and partly worn, so their exact spelling is doubtful. No page number, running head or signature is printed.
